text_block_list.text: One day during training—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That's the cool-down done. Thank 
you for your hard work, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Now then, I need to get ready in a hurry.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, you see~, the donut shop in 
front of the station is doing an 
all-you-can-eat special for today only!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I ate a light lunch just for this, so I 
was so hungry I thought I was gonna 
collapse, ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And on that note, I'm gonna go eat a ton 
and fill my belly up!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I'm a little worried about my weight, 
but if I work hard at training tomorrow, 
it'll be totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, aaah!? Come to think of it, 
tomorrow is the mock race!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was careless... All I could think about 
was donuts...
choice_data_list: You probably shouldn't eat too much.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...No, it'll be fine, I'm sure of it! I 
did today's training thoroughly, after 
all!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, if donuts get you fired up, 
you should eat a whole bunch! Yep, yep!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'm off! See you tomorrow, 
Trainer!!

The next day, Special Week suffered an 
unexpected defeat in the mock race—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, uuuugh...

Late at night, as I was walking back to my 
room, I heard the sound of someone 
sobbing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm such an idiot—!! Uuuuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eep!? T-Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for losing the mock race. 
It's definitely because I ate too many 
donuts, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't crying because I was frustrated 
about losing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I just can't forgive myself for getting 
cocky and underestimating the race...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When I first put on my Racewear, I thought 
I'd finally become a full-fledged racer, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
To think I forgot my original 
intentions... I'm an idiot, an absolute 
mega-idiot!!
choice_data_list:
Let's put this experience to good use 
together.
I'm the one who was too naive.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Even if it's just a mock race, I will 
take it completely seriously!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I don't ever want to feel like this 
again, and I don't want to let you down, 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've cried all I need to, now all that's 
left is to run with all my might! I'm 
going to do some solo training now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'm counting on you! Let's do 
our best together!

Her footsteps echoed across the quiet 
night track as she remembered her original 
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if I ever start saying naive 
things...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"If I ever forget how I felt the first 
time I put on my racewear, please get mad 
at me!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna go run and get my head 
back in the game!

It was an event that served as a reminder 
that dreams are not so easily achieved.
